TartanHacks 2026

🎉 Thank you to everyone who made TartanHacks 2026 a huge success! Congratulations to all the winners and participants! 🎉

Presented by ScottyLabs & 

 TARTANHACKS is the largest Hackathon in Pittsburgh! Organized by ScottyLabs, it's a 24-hour hackathon where participants from all over the country create innovative projects. Come on over to hack, learn from our workshops and incredible speakers, and meet other hackers. 

## The 2026 theme was...

 MOSAIC 

For 24 hours, participants stepped into a world built from fragments, floating tiles, ideas that refract and snap into place.

Nothing arrived whole; everything began as a piece. Teams gathered scattered bits of vision, skill, and code, assembling them into something greater than any single part. Every insight became a tile and every teammate a new color. As the hours passed, the picture sharpened, a Mosaic taking shape.

Entered with fragments. Left with something whole.

#### Scholarship applications are OPEN.

We are dedicated to making WECode accessible to everyone. 

Over the past few years, we've been developing efforts to make our conference as inclusive as possible, and we're grateful to all parties that have enabled us to work towards this ongoing initiative. For the 2026 WECode Conference, we are excited to announce that we're expanding our impact and offering a generous scholarship that will help make the in-person WECode experience possible to more prospective attendees.

The WECode 2027 scholarship covers the full cost of the conference ticket priced at our early bird ticket rate, and provides financial aid for travel and other related expenses. This award amount totaling to $200 will go towards your WECode conference ticket purchase AND related transportation expenses (including but not limited to flight cost, additional food, transportation, etc.). 

These scholarships are limited, and will be distributed to those who 

1. are in the most financial need, and 
2. would benefit the most from the in-person conference experience (demonstrated by essay responses). 

Please note, if you are accepted as a WECode Tech Fellow, your scholarship award amount of $200 excludes the price of the WECode conference ticket as all tech fellows receive free admission to the event. # 2026-2027 NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship

#### Description

The NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship Fund offers the opportunity for technology and supply chain students to attend the 2027 NRF NXT (formerly called NRF Foundation Student Program) in New York City, free of charge. Retail companies, including some of the most exciting brands in the country, are driving big tech innovation. 

 

The NRF Foundation Student Program introduces exciting career paths that might not have been considered, with sessions highlighting the impact tech, supply chain, fulfillment, and data and analytics jobs have on retail businesses.

 

Undergraduate college students pursuing a technology major (computer science, engineering, data science, etc.) or a supply chain major, you could be eligible to receive FREE travel and hotel accommodations to attend the annual NRF Foundation Student Program in New York City.

 

By attending this conference, you will have the opportunity to meet with dozens of retail recruiters hiring for technology and supply chain roles, hear from top leaders and executives in the industry, and explore the most exciting store locations in NYC.

#### Qualifications

• Undergraduate-level sophomore, junior or senior

• Currently pursuing a technology or supply chain major

• Enrolled full-time at an accredited college or university in the United States

• Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale

• At least one job or internship related to your field of study or area(s)

The 2026 ACM SIGMOD/PODS Conference: Bengaluru, India: Student Travel Grants

# SIGMOD 2026 Student Travel Grants

Thanks to the generous support from SIGMOD and other sponsors including the National Science Foundation, we will provide scholarship awards to selected students attending the SIGMOD/PODS conference. The scholarships will include financial support for traveling. 

Each awardee will receive a stipend to partially cover the expense to attend the conference. The amount will be determined based on the availability of funds and the number of granted stipends. Awardees are expected to register to the main conference and will have to make their own arrangements for travel and accommodation. 

## Eligibility

Applicants need to be a full-time student (undergraduate,graduate or PhD). 

Applicants are eligible to apply for the SIGMOD travel award even if they have submissions under consideration at other events at SIGMOD, such as the Undergraduate Research Program, or the New Researcher Symposium. However, an applicant cannot receive more than one travel award in total. 

Applicants do not need to have an accepted paper to be eligible. However, students who are primary authors of an accepted paper in the main conference or the workshops are especially encouraged to apply. Junior students without papers accepted for publication at SIGMOD/PODS, but involved in research closely related to the topics of the conference are also encouraged to apply. The deadline for 2026 LLVM Dev Mtg applications is July 17, 2026.

The deadline for student grant applications has passed.

- Priority may be given to underrepresented backgrounds, genders, and experiences to encourage broader participation in computer science and engineering.
